name: Voting
descriptor: Options with a count each, a bar to the leader, and the leader marked.
verify_checks: tally: the share maths is emitted
pros: a bar to the leader makes the shape of the result obvious
the total and the share are derived, so a correction is instant
a tie marks every leader, which is what a tie means
one device is the right scope for a room, a family or a small team
cons: one device only: there is no ballot box across phones
the count is a number you type, not a button each voter presses
no weighting, no ranking, no rounds
no audit of who voted for what, by design
best_for: tallying a show of hands in one room
avoid_if: the votes come from many devices
